title: Survey-to-Behavior: Downstream Alignment of Human Values in LLMs via Survey Questions
reasoning: The paper investigates value alignment and moral judgment in LLMs, specifically using the MACHIAVELLI benchmark (which measures moral violations and disutility) and the AITA dataset for moral dilemmas. It also includes 'religious faith' and 'religious customs' as specific sub-values within its investigated 'Tradition' value category.
